    def test_case_and_padding_ignored(self):
        a = Contact("a", "Ann@Example.com")
        b = Contact("b", " ann@example.com ")
        c = Contact("c", "ANN@EXAMPLE.COM")
        self.assertEqual(dedupe([a, b, c]), [a])

    def test_blank_emails_never_merge(self):
        entries = [Contact("a", ""), Contact("b", ""), Contact("c", "  ")]
        self.assertEqual(dedupe(entries), entries)

    def test_first_wins_order_kept_input_untouched(self):
        entries = [
            Contact("a", "a@a", "1"),
            Contact("b", "b@b"),
            Contact("a2", "a@a", "2"),
            Contact("c", "c@c"),
        ]
        out = dedupe(entries)
        self.assertEqual([c.name for c in out], ["a", "b", "c"])
        self.assertEqual(out[0], Contact("a", "a@a", "1"))
        self.assertEqual(len(entries), 4)
